map.最关键的是「同一密钥流绝对不能重用」：流密码把明文与密钥流逐位异或，若两组明文用: The most critical rule is "never reuse the same keystream": a stream cipher XORs the plaintext bit-by-bit with the keystream. If two plaintexts use the same keystream (same key + IV/nonce), XORing them cancels the key and yields the XOR of the two plaintexts. Therefore every encryption must use a unique nonce; also, stream ciphers provide no integrity protection, so pair them with a MAC or use an AEAD.
map.密钥（16 字节：32 hex 字符；文本按 UTF-8 补齐）: Key (16 bytes: 32 hex chars; text padded as UTF-8)
map.按 RFC 4503 实现：128 位密钥按小端切成 K0=密钥末两字节…K7=: RFC 4503 compliant: the 128-bit key is split into little-endian subkeys K0=last two key bytes … K7=first two, loaded into eight state words X and eight counter words C per section 2.3, iterated four times, then C_j ^= X[(j+4) mod 8]. With an 8-byte IV, section 2.4 XORs four 16-bit IV slices into C0/C4, C1/C5, C2/C6 and C3/C7 before four more iterations. Each round updates counters per section 2.5: temp=C_j+A_j+b, b=temp divided by 2^32 and carried into the next word and round, C_j=temp mod 2^32 (b is not added back to C0); section 2.6 computes g(u,v)=LSW((u+v)^2) XOR MSW((u+v)^2) to advance X; section 2.7 extracts 16 keystream bytes, emitted from S[127..0] high byte first and XORed with plaintext/ciphertext byte by byte. A 32-hex-char key is loaded as raw bytes; text keys are UTF-8 padded to 16 bytes and rejected with an error if longer, never silently truncated
map.Rabbit 以 128 位密钥 + 64 位 IV 驱动内部状态，生成密钥流异: Rabbit drives its internal state with a 128-bit key + 64-bit IV, generating a keystream to XOR with the plaintext. RFC 4503 vector: with an all-zero key and all-zero IV the first 16 keystream bytes are C6 A7 27 5E F8 54 95 D8 7C CD 5D 37 67 05 B7 ED; reproduce it with a 32-hex-char key and 16-hex-char IV.
